title: Revenue Accounting Annexe for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Booking Age Surcharges on a Credit Reissue Fee
content:
A surcharge in dollars is added to the fee charged for a credit reissue under Air Ticket Fare Brands according to how long ago the booking behind the lapsed credit was opened, and it is added once for the booking. The age of the booking is taken in whole calendar months from the day the booking was opened to the handling date. The older-booking term is 18 months and the archived-booking term is 36 months.

| Age of the booking | What is added |
| --- | --- |
| Opened longer ago than 36 whole calendar months | The archived-booking surcharge of 45.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged, once for the booking |
| Opened longer ago than 18 whole calendar months but not longer ago than 36 | The older-booking surcharge of 20.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged, once for the booking |
| Opened not longer ago than 18 whole calendar months | Nothing is added to the fee charged for the age of the booking |

Determination on hypothetical dates, the handling date being 17 September 2026:

* a booking opened on 17 August 2023 stands at 37 whole calendar months, longer ago than the archived-booking term, so 45.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged;
* a booking opened on 17 September 2023 stands at exactly 36 whole calendar months, which is not longer ago than that term, so 20.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged;
* a booking opened on 17 February 2025 stands at 19 whole calendar months, longer ago than the older-booking term, so 20.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged;
* a booking opened on 17 March 2025 stands at exactly 18 whole calendar months, which is not longer ago than that term, so nothing is added to the fee charged for the age of the booking.
